biggest_catch: The bonus pays on or before March 1, 2027 — roughly 4 to 6 months after you open — and you must make 20 real debit-card purchases by February 1, 2027; ATM withdrawals and pending transactions do not count.
catches: The promo code 200Digital826 must be provided at the time of account opening — accounts opened without it do not qualify.
The account must be opened between August 28, 2026 and October 27, 2026; opening after October 27 earns nothing.
At least 20 purchases using the new associated debit card must be completed by February 1, 2027; ATM withdrawals, pending transactions, and branch withdrawals with the debit card do not count.

Commerce Bank determines whether all requirements are met as of February 1, 2027; the bonus is paid on or before March 1, 2027, by crediting the new checking account — only if the account remains open.

Eligible accounts: Commerce Free, Commerce Relationship, or Commerce Interest checking. Commerce Free has no monthly fee; Commerce Interest has a $12 monthly fee (waived first 60 days, then requires $500+ direct deposit or $1,000 daily balance).

Not available to anyone who owned a Commerce Bank checking account or received a previous Commerce checking bonus in the 12 months before opening; one offer per household; cannot be combined with other checking offers.
Maximum total bonus $200; the bonus is reported as interest to the IRS; offer may be revoked, restricted, or changed at any time at Commerce Bank's sole discretion.

steps: Go to the official Commerce Bank offer page https://www.commercebank.com/personal/2026/w4/200checking and confirm the offer is still showing before you apply (it ends October 27, 2026).
Open a new Commerce Free, Commerce Relationship, or Commerce Interest checking account between August 28, 2026 and October 27, 2026, providing promo code 200Digital826 at the time of account opening.
Activate the new debit card linked to the account.
Complete at least 20 purchases with the new debit card by February 1, 2027 — real point-of-sale purchases only; ATM withdrawals and pending transactions do not count.
Keep the account open; Commerce Bank evaluates requirements as of February 1, 2027 and pays the $200 bonus on or before March 1, 2027 by crediting the new account.
Use Commerce Free checking to avoid monthly fees entirely (Commerce Interest charges $12/month after the first 60 days unless you keep a $500+ direct deposit or $1,000 daily balance).
timing: Requirements evaluated as of February 1, 2027; bonus paid on or before March 1, 2027 by crediting the new checking account.
